text_block_list.text:
Losing sucks, sure... but dragging it out 
looks totally uncool, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you've got time to make excuses— then 
you've only got time to train like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You better come with me as soon as 
we get back! I'm gonna polish up my skills 
and cool factor even more!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Look at you talking big. Guess 
that's my Trainer for ya.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! If anything, this loss 
just got my engine runnin' even hotter!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I'll pour your expectations and 
my own frustration straight into the fuel 
tank—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"In the next race, I'll show off my cool 
running for the whole world to see!!"
